# random { #deep_tensor.GaussianReference.random }

```python
GaussianReference.random(d: int, n: int)
```

Generates a set of random samples.

Generates a set of random samples from the reference density.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**d**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The dimension of the samples.

<code>[**n**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The number of samples to draw.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**rs**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An $n \times d$ matrix containing the generated samples.
